comment: Base is vaultwarden's own web-vault fork (vaultwarden/vw_web_builds) at the tag the companion vaultwarden ships (docker/DockerSettings.yaml vault_version v2026.8.0). This fork already carries vaultwarden's patches - no Bitwarden cloud/billing/license cruft - which is why bw_web_builds checks it out instead of patching bitwarden/clients on the fly. Our SM overlay and /sm route go on top. Move in lockstep with vaultwarden's vault_version.
